capabilities.name: Add and subtract within 100 mentally
capabilities.name_zh: 100以内加减法心算
capabilities.description: Fluently add and subtract two-digit numbers without writing the vertical form.

capabilities.name: Add multi-digit numbers with regrouping
capabilities.name_zh: 多位数进位加法笔算
capabilities.description: Perform column addition of numbers up to 10,000 with carrying.

capabilities.name: Subtract multi-digit numbers with regrouping
capabilities.name_zh: 多位数退位减法笔算
capabilities.description: Perform column subtraction of numbers up to 10,000 with borrowing.

capabilities.name: Recall multiplication facts up to 10×10
capabilities.name_zh: 熟记表内乘法口诀
capabilities.description: Quickly recall products of single-digit numbers.

capabilities.name: Multiply a multi-digit number by a 1-digit number
capabilities.name_zh: 多位数乘一位数
capabilities.description: Compute products like 216×3 using the standard algorithm.

capabilities.name: Multiply a multi-digit number by a 2-digit number
capabilities.name_zh: 多位数乘两位数
capabilities.description: Compute products like 23×14 using the standard algorithm with partial products.

capabilities.name: Multiply by multiples of 10, 100, 1000
capabilities.name_zh: 乘整十、整百、整千数
capabilities.description: Use place value to multiply numbers ending in zeros efficiently.

capabilities.name: Divide a multi-digit number by a 1-digit number (exact)
capabilities.name_zh: 多位数除以一位数（整除）
capabilities.description: Perform division with no remainder using the long division algorithm.

capabilities.name: Divide with remainders and interpret the remainder
capabilities.name_zh: 有余数的除法及余数含义
capabilities.description: Perform division where a remainder exists and explain what the remainder represents in context.

capabilities.name: Apply order of operations with parentheses
capabilities.name_zh: 含括号的四则运算顺序
capabilities.description: Evaluate expressions involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and parentheses correctly.

capabilities.name: Use the commutative and associative properties to simplify computation
capabilities.name_zh: 运用交换律和结合律简算
capabilities.description: Rearrange numbers in addition or multiplication to make mental calculation easier.

capabilities.name: Use the distributive property to simplify multiplication
capabilities.name_zh: 运用分配律简算
capabilities.description: Break a factor into a sum to compute products like (300+2)×23 or 125×(80+8).

capabilities.name: Estimate sums, differences, products and quotients
capabilities.name_zh: 估算四则运算结果
capabilities.description: Round numbers to the nearest ten or hundred to quickly approximate a result.

capabilities.name: Check calculation results by inverse operation or estimation
capabilities.name_zh: 用逆运算或估算检验结果
capabilities.description: Verify an answer by performing the opposite operation or comparing with an estimate.

capabilities.name: Multiply by 11 using the quick mental trick
capabilities.name_zh: 乘11的速算技巧
capabilities.description: Use the 'add the two digits and put in the middle' method for 11× a two-digit number.

capabilities.name: Divide by using the splitting method
capabilities.name_zh: 拆数连除巧算
capabilities.description: Combine divisions or split dividends, e.g., (a+b)÷c, or a÷b÷c = a÷(b×c).

capabilities.name: Fluently compute multi-step arithmetic expressions with whole numbers
capabilities.name_zh: 整数四则混合运算综合
capabilities.description: Accurately and efficiently perform any combination of the four operations with whole numbers within the course range.

capabilities.name: Recognize odd and even numbers
capabilities.name_zh: 认识奇数和偶数
capabilities.description: Identify a whole number as odd or even.

capabilities.name: Predict parity of sums, products and differences
capabilities.name_zh: 判断四则运算结果的奇偶性
capabilities.description: Determine whether the result of an expression is odd or even without computing the exact value.

capabilities.name: Test divisibility by 2, 5, and 10
capabilities.name_zh: 用2、5、10整除特征判断
capabilities.description: Decide if a number is divisible by 2, 5, or 10 using the last digit rule.

capabilities.name: Test divisibility by 3 and 9
capabilities.name_zh: 用3和9整除特征判断
capabilities.description: Decide if a number is divisible by 3 or 9 using the sum of digits rule.

capabilities.name: Understand place value up to 100,000 and expanded form
capabilities.name_zh: 十万以内位值制与数的拆分
capabilities.description: Read, write, and decompose numbers into place values (ones, tens, hundreds, thousands, ten thousands).

capabilities.name: Compare and order large numbers
capabilities.name_zh: 大数比较与排序
capabilities.description: Use place value to determine which of two numbers is larger and arrange a set in order.

capabilities.name: Round whole numbers to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand
capabilities.name_zh: 四舍五入近似数
capabilities.description: Approximate a number to a specified place value by rounding.

capabilities.name: Understand decimal notation for tenths and hundredths
capabilities.name_zh: 认识一位及两位小数
capabilities.description: Read and write decimals like 3.43 and explain the meaning of the digits after the decimal point.

capabilities.name: Multiply and divide decimals by 10, 100 by shifting the decimal point
capabilities.name_zh: 小数点移动引起小数大小变化
capabilities.description: Move the decimal point to quickly compute 0.3343×10 or 80.8÷100.

capabilities.name: Apply number properties and place value reasoning to solve puzzles
capabilities.name_zh: 用数的性质解数字谜题
capabilities.description: Solve non-routine problems involving odd/even, divisibility, place value, and missing digits.

capabilities.name: Convert between centimetres, metres and kilometres
capabilities.name_zh: 长度单位换算（厘米、米、千米）
capabilities.description: Change a given length into a different unit within the metric system.

capabilities.name: Add and subtract money in yuan, jiao, fen
capabilities.name_zh: 人民币元角分加减计算
capabilities.description: Perform computations with decimal money notation.

capabilities.name: Read an analog clock and compute elapsed time within an hour
capabilities.name_zh: 认读钟表及计算经过时间
capabilities.description: Tell time to the minute and find how many minutes pass between two times.

capabilities.name: Use a calendar to find the day of the week for a future date
capabilities.name_zh: 用日历推算星期几
capabilities.description: Compute the day of the week after a given number of days using periodicity of 7.

capabilities.name: Understand the concept of speed (distance per unit time)
capabilities.name_zh: 理解速度概念
capabilities.description: Relate distance, time and speed; compute one when the other two are known for a single moving object.

capabilities.name: Understand work rate (amount done per unit time)
capabilities.name_zh: 理解工作效率概念
capabilities.description: Calculate the amount one unit (person, machine) can do in one unit of time, or the total work done.

capabilities.name: Compute the perimeter of polygons by adding side lengths
capabilities.name_zh: 计算多边形的周长（直接加）
capabilities.description: Find the perimeter by summing all side lengths of a given figure.

capabilities.name: Apply perimeter formulas for rectangle and square
capabilities.name_zh: 运用长方形、正方形周长公式
capabilities.description: Compute perimeter using the standard formulas and find a missing side length given the perimeter.

capabilities.name: Compute perimeter of composite rectilinear figures
capabilities.name_zh: 计算组合图形的周长
capabilities.description: Find the perimeter of L-shapes and other figures made of rectangles by adding outer sides, sometimes with translation of edges.

capabilities.name: Understand area as covering with unit squares
capabilities.name_zh: 理解面积含义（单位面积）
capabilities.description: Explain area as the number of unit squares that cover a shape without gaps.

capabilities.name: Apply area formulas for rectangle and square
capabilities.name_zh: 运用长方形、正方形面积公式
capabilities.description: Compute area using length × width for rectangles and side × side for squares.

capabilities.name: Compute area of composite figures by adding or subtracting rectangles
capabilities.name_zh: 用割补法求组合图形面积
capabilities.description: Find the area of a complex shape by splitting it into rectangles or subtracting a rectangle from a larger one.

capabilities.name: Compute area of a parallelogram
capabilities.name_zh: 计算平行四边形面积
capabilities.description: Use the formula base × height to find the area of a parallelogram.

capabilities.name: Compute area of a trapezoid
capabilities.name_zh: 计算梯形面积
capabilities.description: Use the formula (upper base + lower base) × height ÷ 2 to find the area of a trapezoid.

capabilities.name: Compute area of a quadrilateral with perpendicular diagonals
capabilities.name_zh: 用对角线垂直求四边形面积
capabilities.description: Use the formula (diagonal1 × diagonal2) ÷ 2 for a kite or rhombus.

capabilities.name: Identify right, acute and obtuse angles
capabilities.name_zh: 辨认直角、锐角和钝角
capabilities.description: Classify an angle by comparing it to a right angle (90°).

capabilities.name: Identify complementary and supplementary angle pairs
capabilities.name_zh: 认识余角和补角
capabilities.description: Recognize when two angles sum to 90° or 180° and find a missing angle.

capabilities.name: Identify parallel and perpendicular lines
capabilities.name_zh: 判断平行和垂直
capabilities.description: Decide whether two given lines are parallel or perpendicular.

capabilities.name: Classify quadrilaterals by properties
capabilities.name_zh: 按边角特征分类四边形
capabilities.description: Distinguish squares, rectangles, and parallelograms based on side lengths, parallelism, and angles.

capabilities.name: Count basic rectangles and triangles in a figure
capabilities.name_zh: 数图形中的长方形和三角形
capabilities.description: Use systematic enumeration (by size) or the area-marking method to count the number of a given shape in a diagram.

capabilities.name: Apply inclusion-exclusion to count overlapping shapes
capabilities.name_zh: 用容斥原理数复杂图形
capabilities.description: Count shapes in a compound figure by adding counts of parts and subtracting overlaps.

capabilities.name: Solve area and perimeter problems in real-world contexts
capabilities.name_zh: 解决实际中的周长面积问题
capabilities.description: Apply formulas and strategies to problems like paving paths, cutting shapes, or combining figures.

capabilities.name: Identify and extend an arithmetic sequence
capabilities.name_zh: 认识并续写等差数列
capabilities.description: Find the common difference and list subsequent terms in a sequence.

capabilities.name: Find a specific term of an arithmetic sequence
capabilities.name_zh: 求等差数列的第n项
capabilities.description: Use the formula first term + (n-1)×common difference to find a distant term.

capabilities.name: Sum an arithmetic series by the pairing method
capabilities.name_zh: 用配对法求等差数列的和
capabilities.description: Compute the sum of a series like 1+2+...+20 by pairing first and last terms.

capabilities.name: Use the middle term property in an arithmetic sequence
capabilities.name_zh: 利用等差数列中项定理
capabilities.description: Find the sum or a middle term when the number of terms is odd.

capabilities.name: Identify and continue periodic patterns
capabilities.name_zh: 找周期规律并应用
capabilities.description: Recognize a repeating cycle (e.g., bead colors, days of the week) and determine the element at any position.

capabilities.name: Find a number by its position in a number table
capabilities.name_zh: 在数表中按行列定位找数
capabilities.description: Given a table filled by rules, find the number at a given row and column, or vice versa.

capabilities.name: Describe and extend growing geometric patterns
capabilities.name_zh: 描述并续写几何图形变化规律
capabilities.description: Find the rule for the number of shapes in each step and predict later steps.

capabilities.name: Calculate the average (mean) of a set of numbers
capabilities.name_zh: 计算平均数
capabilities.description: Sum the values and divide by the count to find the mean.

capabilities.name: Use average to find a total or missing value
capabilities.name_zh: 利用平均数求总量或未知值
capabilities.description: Given the average and count, compute the total; given all but one number and the average, find the missing number.

capabilities.name: Translate a one-step word problem into an arithmetic expression
capabilities.name_zh: 将简单应用题转化为算式
capabilities.description: Identify the operation needed (add, subtract, multiply, divide) from a single-step story and write the computation.

capabilities.name: Solve two-step word problems involving mixed operations
capabilities.name_zh: 解决两步混合运算应用题
capabilities.description: Plan and carry out two calculations where the operations may differ.

capabilities.name: Draw a line-segment diagram to represent comparison relationships
capabilities.name_zh: 画线段图表示数量比较关系
capabilities.description: Visually model 'a is b times as many' or 'a is more/less than b' relationships to plan a solution.

capabilities.name: Solve problems with 'a times as many plus/ minus a constant'
capabilities.name_zh: 解决几倍多/少的比较问题
capabilities.description: Find unknown quantities when one is described as multiple times another plus/minus a fixed amount.

capabilities.name: Solve age problems involving sums and differences over time
capabilities.name_zh: 解决年龄和差问题
capabilities.description: Account for the fact that everyone's age increases equally; use sum and differences to find ages.

capabilities.name: Solve money problems involving unit price, quantity, and total cost
capabilities.name_zh: 解决单价、数量、总价问题
capabilities.description: Use multiplication or division to find one of price, quantity, or total cost.

capabilities.name: Solve single-object distance-speed-time problems
capabilities.name_zh: 解决单一物体路程速度时间问题
capabilities.description: Given two of distance, speed, time, find the third for one moving object.

capabilities.name: Solve meeting problems (two objects moving toward each other)
capabilities.name_zh: 解决相遇问题
capabilities.description: Use the relationship (speed1+speed2)×time = total distance to find unknown.

capabilities.name: Solve catching-up problems
capabilities.name_zh: 解决追及问题
capabilities.description: Use (speed difference)×time = initial distance gap to find when a faster object overtakes a slower one.

capabilities.name: Solve round-trip / return meeting problems
capabilities.name_zh: 解决折返相遇问题
capabilities.description: Analyze motion where one party reaches an endpoint and returns to meet the other.

capabilities.name: Solve distribution problems with excess and deficit
capabilities.name_zh: 解决盈亏分配问题
capabilities.description: Given two scenarios of distributing items to groups (one short, one surplus), find the number of groups and total items.

capabilities.name: Solve problems using the 'assume all' strategy (chicken-rabbit type)
capabilities.name_zh: 用假设法解决鸡兔同笼问题
capabilities.description: Assume all items are one type, compute the difference in totals, and deduce the actual composition.

capabilities.name: Solve problems by working backwards
capabilities.name_zh: 用倒推法解决问题
capabilities.description: Start from the final result and reverse each step of a described process to find the starting value.

capabilities.name: Use systematic listing to solve enumeration problems
capabilities.name_zh: 用枚举法不重不漏地列举
capabilities.description: List all possibilities for a combination or arrangement by fixing one variable and varying others systematically.

capabilities.name: Use a table to organize information and find patterns
capabilities.name_zh: 列表整理信息找规律
capabilities.description: Construct a table to record repeated operations or possibilities, then identify a pattern or solution.

capabilities.name: Solve redistribution problems (giving to make equal)
capabilities.name_zh: 解决移多补少/等量调配问题
capabilities.description: Determine original amounts when items are moved between parties and final relationships are known.

capabilities.name: Solve multi-person work rate problems
capabilities.name_zh: 解决多人/多机的工作效率问题
capabilities.description: Use normalization to 1 unit per time, then scale up to the required number of units and time.

capabilities.name: Solve problems involving a missing-digit error in numbers
capabilities.name_zh: 解决数字错漏问题（如漏0）
capabilities.description: Determine original numbers when a mistake (like missing a trailing zero) leads to an erroneous result.

capabilities.name: Form largest/smallest numbers under matchstick-digit constraints
capabilities.name_zh: 在给定资源下构造最值数字
capabilities.description: Arrange digits to maximize or minimize the number when each digit costs a fixed number of matchsticks.

capabilities.name: Solve interval problems (planting trees, flags) on a line
capabilities.name_zh: 解决直线上的植树/间隔问题
capabilities.description: Relate the number of objects to the number of intervals, considering whether ends are included.

capabilities.name: Solve interval problems on a closed loop (circle)
capabilities.name_zh: 解决封闭图形上的植树问题
capabilities.description: Understand that on a circle, the number of objects equals the number of intervals.

capabilities.name: Solve square array problems (outer layer count, total count)
capabilities.name_zh: 解决方阵问题（空心/实心）
capabilities.description: Calculate the number of people on the outermost layer or total number in a square arrangement, including hollow arrays.

capabilities.name: Solve simple optimization problems in context
capabilities.name_zh: 解决简单的最优化问题
capabilities.description: Compare options (e.g., shipping routes, purchase packages) to minimize cost or distance under constraints.

capabilities.name: Plan and solve multi-step word problems independently
capabilities.name_zh: 独立规划并解决多步应用题
capabilities.description: Read a complex problem, identify knowns and unknowns, choose a strategy, execute a multi-step plan, and interpret the answer.

capabilities.name: Apply exponent rules (product of powers) to solve simple exponential equations
capabilities.name_zh: 运用指数运算法则解简单方程
capabilities.description: Rewrite numbers with the same base and equate exponents, e.g., 3^m · 9^3 · 27^3 · 81^m = 3^30.

capabilities.name: Solve inclusion-exclusion problems for two overlapping sets (Venn diagram)
capabilities.name_zh: 用韦恩图解决两集容斥问题
capabilities.description: Given totals for each set, the intersection, and possibly the outside, find any missing value.

capabilities.name: Apply inclusion-exclusion for counting items satisfying multiple conditions
capabilities.name_zh: 用容斥原理解决灯开关类问题
capabilities.description: Count how many numbers satisfy none or exactly some of several divisibility conditions, as in the light-switch problem.

capabilities.name: Count the number of shortest paths on a grid
capabilities.name_zh: 计算网格最短路径条数
capabilities.description: Use the addition method (Pascal's triangle) to count ways from one corner to another, including obstacles.

capabilities.name: Determine if a graph can be drawn in one stroke
capabilities.name_zh: 判断一笔画可行性和画法
capabilities.description: Count odd vertices and decide if the figure can be drawn without lifting the pen, and find a route.

capabilities.name: Solve magic square problems
capabilities.name_zh: 补充幻方使行列对角线和相等
capabilities.description: Use the constant-sum property to find missing numbers in a square so that each row, column, and diagonal sums to the same value.

capabilities.name: Solve cryptarithm puzzles (digit-symbol substitutions)
capabilities.name_zh: 解算符谜题（数字竖式谜）
capabilities.description: Determine the digits behind symbols or letters in addition/subtraction/multiplication vertical forms using carrying and number properties.

capabilities.name: Solve logic puzzles with true/false statements
capabilities.name_zh: 解决真假话逻辑推理题
capabilities.description: Deduce facts from statements where some are true and some false, using contradiction or assumption.

capabilities.name: Solve tent-and-tree style grid puzzles
capabilities.name_zh: 解决帐篷-树逻辑网格题
capabilities.description: Place objects on a grid satisfying adjacency and row/column count constraints.

capabilities.name: Count map-coloring arrangements with adjacency constraints
capabilities.name_zh: 计算地图涂色方案数
capabilities.description: Find the number of valid colorings of regions given that adjacent regions have different colors.

capabilities.name: Use a tree diagram to enumerate sequential choices
capabilities.name_zh: 画树状图列举分步选择
capabilities.description: Draw a branching diagram to list all possible sequences of decisions, avoiding omissions.

capabilities.name: Use parity invariants to reason about possible transformations
capabilities.name_zh: 用奇偶不变性分析棋子跳动等问题
capabilities.description: Identify a quantity (e.g., sum of coordinates) that remains even or odd to prove a configuration is impossible.

capabilities.name: Define and evaluate a new operation defined by a rule
capabilities.name_zh: 根据自定义运算规则求值
capabilities.description: Compute expressions like a※b = 3a−2b given the definition, including nested uses.

capabilities.name: Solve non-routine puzzles and logical challenges
capabilities.name_zh: 综合运用逻辑推理解决非典型谜题
capabilities.description: Combine logical deduction, enumeration, invariants, and trial to solve puzzles beyond standard word problems.
